title: Genre Tops List: Signature Battery Designs
name: Genre Tops List: Signature Battery Designs
description: The genre tops list — the highest-standing works in each genre, chosen for influence, craft, and staying power. Signature Originals: Everclover Perennial Cell; Signature Prism Cell; Signature Rainbow Charge Cell; Leprechaun Pot Cell; Thunderhead Surge Cell.
how_it_works: Browse each genre group, then compare the tops list against the archive.
key_points: Signature Originals — Everclover Perennial Cell, Signature Prism Cell, Signature Rainbow Charge Cell, Leprechaun Pot Cell, Thunderhead Surge Cell

demo.program:
# Genre Tops List: Signature Battery Designs -- self-test demo
qa = [
    ("Signature Originals", "Everclover Perennial Cell"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print("Q%d: %s" % (i, q))
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    ok = ans and ans in a.lower()
    print("Correct!" if ok else "Answer: " + a)
    score += ok
print("Score: %d/%d" % (score, len(qa)))
